frames.description: OBSERVED: full-bleed dark green circuit-board HUD. Center chip reads J.A.R.V.I.S. in spaced letters. Top-left NEURAL LINK - CONNECTED. Top-right SPEAKING + clock. Bottom-left MIC - LISTENING FOR "JARVIS". Bottom-right SAY "JARVIS" - OR TAP SPACE. No Observe card. No Mouth card. No two-column dashboard.
OBSERVED: same living PCB face. Center chip J.A.R.V.I.S. with yellow-green glow. Top-right SPEAKING + green orb. Traces and nodes fill the whole viewport. Wake-word chrome still in the corners.
OBSERVED: talking-head cut. Jared on camera (cap, boom mic, Secretlab chair). Green overlay Site: jaredrhod.com. Visualizer not on screen this beat.
OBSERVED: talking-head continues while he names the visualizer he will show. Not the PCB this cut.

OBSERVED: back on the visualizer. He talks to it ("Jarvis, let's just show them"). Center chip is a cyan waveform, not the name. Status LISTENING + green orb. Jared webcam inset bottom-left. Corners still wake-word HUD. Full-screen PCB, no cards.
OBSERVED: Jarvis answers. Center chip back to J.A.R.V.I.S. Status SPEAKING. DEVICE LIVE - CONNECTED. Mic still listening for Jarvis. He uses voice, not a type box.
OBSERVED: SPEAKING. Chip J.A.R.V.I.S. with scan-line glow. Jared talking in the inset. Traces pulse. Spoken: visualizer, lights and presence that react while talking.
OBSERVED: still the same PCB face while Jarvis talks memory. No second pane.
OBSERVED: Jared talks to the face again ("Well, Jarvis..."). Visualizer remains the only product UI.

OBSERVED: THINKING state. Center chip shows a scramble of glyphs instead of the name. Top-right THINKING + clock + green orb. Bottom-right PROCESSING... Mic still listening for Jarvis. PCB traces brighter at center.
OBSERVED: visualizer still full-bleed while Jarvis talks Claude Code / hands. Hive remap later; pixels are still the PCB face.
OBSERVED: SPEAKING. Chip J.A.R.V.I.S. He says the visualizer is this whole setup reacting while he talks. Webcam inset. No Observe/Mouth chrome.
OBSERVED: READY / LIVE / CONNECTED top-left. SPEAKING top-right. Same circuit board. Say Jarvis or tap Space still the use.
OBSERVED: talking-head / install talk. Visualizer not the cut.
OBSERVED: talking-head naming Obsidian vault for memory files. Not PCB.
OBSERVED: Bare Hands 3D board (optional extra). Not the face. Hands stay parked for hive.
OBSERVED: wrap. Spoken: the visualizer is the circuit board you just saw. Confirms the face on the tape is the PCB HUD, not a particle orb and not a two-card desk.
